source_notes: Attributions follow the Crowley Thoth system. Pip decans use the standard decan table (Thoth pip names and planets as in the Book of Thoth). Court spans run from 21 degrees of the first sign to 20 degrees of the second. Aces and Princesses rule a quadrant above the North Pole. Planetary majors carry no element. Thoth URLs are the card pages on thothreadings.com.
